author: Darcus7
quote:
Writing is bad, characters are generally uninteresting though Lucia seems to be even worse than Jason. And Jason is a flavorless and a generic character that as if popped out of Wattpad.

FPS drops on PS5 and the way it seems the FPS is still tied to the physics speed of the game. So there would be gameplay differences between FPSs when it finally makes a release at PC. As if we are playing a WWE 2K Game. And its literally 2026. Rockstar should have done better.

Gameplay contains more bugs than the previous GTA 5 release or the RDR2 release. Which even with delays in release of GTA 6. Explosion effects seems out of character for a GTA game. And even looks like a cheap mobile knockoff rather than the original.

Storywise, both characters never get big enough for the story to matter and both drowns in the world weight. Which is a change from previous titles that wouldnt meet the player bases expectations.

Chores, game forces you to do chores and steals the fun out from you for you playing the GTA like you always had while locking you from the good endings.
